text:
anya: final sunporch WFH battlestation reveal: hammock as a desk (yes, really) + tiny mesh AP on the windowsill. photo: https://imgur.com/a/xyz123 attached. no glare, lots of plants, cat is suspicious :cat2:

sam: hammock = ergonomic? or just dramatic zoom backgrounds 😂

mike: looks awesome. how's zoom latency / packet loss with the weird window setup?

anya: surprisingly solid. i'm running a UniFi AC-Mesh as the AP in the window and using the old TP-Link as a bridged AP inside. if the main drops i failover to my phone hotspot with policy routing. so far only a hiccup when the neighbor runs their microwave :grimacing:

lina: can you paste the hotspot failover ip rule? i might copy it for my lakehouse setup

anya: sure — minimal example i use on my edge router:
```
# mark traffic for hotspot route
iptables -t mangle -A PREROUTING -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -p tcp --dport 443 -j MARK --set-mark 0x1
ip rule add fwmark 0x1 table 200 pref 100
ip route add default via 192.168.43.1 dev usb0 table 200 metric 1000
```

mike: nice, thanks. curious — any auto-switch script or manual?

anya: i have a tiny systemd service that watches ping to 8.8.8.8 and flips the default route. super crude but works: checks every 10s, switches back after 2 successful pings on main.

opsbot: deploy-bot: heads up — product onboarding demo in 15m (not related to hammocks) :bell:

sam: poll: hammock vs standing desk? react with :thumbsup: for hammock, :raised_hands: for standing.

mike: also — can you upload the cat pic pls?

anya: uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/attachments/sunporch-cat.jpg :heart:

lina: what exact models are you using for the APs? might get one for my balcony

anya: UniFi AC Mesh (outdoor) + TP-Link Archer C7 as indoor bridge. saved config snapshot at /home/anya/router-backup.tar.gz if anyone wants it.

sam: amazing. if anyone wants me to iperf3 from their endpoint to the hammock desk for science, ping me and i'll run a quick test :microscope:
